info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Open Banking Event Subscriptions-spec
info.description: This API provides access to information about event subscriptions related to Open Banking. By leveraging this endpoint, developers can query the active subscriptions to various events, allowing for integration and monitoring of banking activities. Typical consumers include financial service providers and application developers who need to stay informed of relevant banking events. The API allows for efficient retrieval of subscription details, enhancing operational awareness and service interaction.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of event subscriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve all event subscriptions currently available in the system. You can use this to view details of each subscription and monitor events effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to fetch event subscriptions. It should be formatted as JSON and adhere to the defined schema to ensure proper processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of event subscriptions.
